title: Analysis of pig appeasing pheromone effects on social behaviour and welfare in group-housed sows using computer vision
description: Research code and supporting processed data accompanying the study "Analysis of pig appeasing pheromone effects on social behaviour and welfare in group-housed sows using computer vision". The study used a double-blind, replicated design to evaluate pig appeasing pheromone diffusers in groups of 16-20 gestating sows monitored continuously for 17 days. The repository supports the computer-vision pipeline for sow segmentation, identification and tracking; the automated analysis of movement, fighting, fleeing and displacement; tracking and behaviour-detection validation; skin-lesion and behavioural summaries; and the statistical analyses reported in the manuscript.
